title: [GMCP 203.047.M] Mastery: Documentation, examples, developer experience, release quality, and SLOs
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-047-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Versioned operator, author, host, security, migration, troubleshooting and architecture documentation is executable and matches shipped behavior; examples cover every primitive and official extension from minimal to production. One-command setup and diagnostics pass usability studies, releases carry compatibility/SBOM/provenance evidence, and published availability, recovery, performance and support SLOs are measured with error-budget policy. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
